verdict.rationale: Bento's own 'signals' come closest to this story. You describe a failure mode in plain English, Bento trains a detector on your traces that fires in real time and backfills history, and each signal's prompt and config can be edited. The docs never say these detectors are LLM-as-a-judge, and they flag failures rather than produce explicit output scores. Release scoring exists, but the evaluator behind it is not described. Missing for 10: explicit LLM-as-a-judge evaluator documentation, configurable judge model/rubric/scoring scales, documented per-output scores, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
